fields.summary: orders-api pods OOMKilled during the nightly batch import (case 0)

content.text:
Caller: Jane Doe
Pods restart every night. Last State: Terminated Reason: OOMKilled Exit Code: 137.
Reported by Jane Doe <jane.doe@example.com>.

2026-10-01 09:12:41 - Jane Doe (Work notes)
Root cause: the import loaded the whole catalogue into memory. Checked with @jdoe; call +1 555 123 4567 or mail jane.doe@example.com if it comes back.
Raised the memory limit to 1Gi and changed the import to stream pages of 500 rows.

fields.summary: ImagePullBackOff for payments after the registry move (case 1)
fields.description:
Caller: Raj Patel
Failed to pull image quay.io/acme/payments:2.3.1: unauthorized: authentication required.
Reported by Raj Patel <raj.patel@example.org>.

comments.body:
2026-10-02 09:12:41 - Raj Patel (Work notes)
Cause was a pull secret that still pointed at the old registry. Checked with @rpatel; call (555) 987-6543 or mail raj.patel@example.org if it comes back.
Linked the new pull secret to the default ServiceAccount in payments and restarted the rollout.

fields.summary: etcd leader changes every few minutes after the 4.21.0 update (case 2)

content.text:
Caller: Ana Lima
etcdHighNumberOfLeaderChanges is firing on all masters; API requests time out.
Reported by Ana Lima <ana.lima@example.net>.

2026-10-03 09:12:41 - Ana Lima (Work notes)
Root cause: catalog sync wrote to the control-plane disks every few seconds. Checked with @alima; call +44 20 7946 0958 or mail ana.lima@example.net if it comes back.
Updated the cluster to 4.21.1, which fixes the catalog sync I/O on the control plane.

fields.summary: Route returns 503 for shop frontend (case 3)
fields.description:
Caller: Jane Doe
The router answers 503 Service Unavailable for shop.apps.example.test.
Reported by Jane Doe <jane.doe@example.com>.

comments.body:
2026-10-04 09:12:41 - Jane Doe (Work notes)
Cause: the Service selected no pods. Checked with @jdoe; call +1 555 123 4567 or mail jane.doe@example.com if it comes back.
The Service selector used app=front instead of app=frontend; corrected the selector.

fields.summary: PVC stuck Pending for the reporting database (case 4)

content.text:
Caller: Raj Patel
persistentvolumeclaim/report-db is Pending: no persistent volumes available and no storage class.
Reported by Raj Patel <raj.patel@example.org>.

2026-10-05 09:12:41 - Raj Patel (Work notes)
Root cause was a claim without a storage class on a cluster with no default class. Checked with @rpatel; call (555) 987-6543 or mail raj.patel@example.org if it comes back.
Set storageClassName gp3-csi on the claim and recreated it.

fields.summary: Pods rejected by SCC in the batch namespace (case 5)
fields.description:
Caller: Ana Lima
unable to validate against any security context constraint: runAsUser 0 is not an allowed user.
Reported by Ana Lima <ana.lima@example.net>.

comments.body:
2026-10-06 09:12:41 - Ana Lima (Work notes)
Cause: the chart hard-codes runAsUser for vanilla Kubernetes. Checked with @alima; call +44 20 7946 0958 or mail ana.lima@example.net if it comes back.
Removed runAsUser 0 from the Deployment so restricted-v2 assigns a UID from the namespace range.

fields.summary: DNS lookups time out from the analytics pods (case 6)

content.text:
Caller: Jane Doe
dial tcp: lookup db.analytics.svc on 172.30.0.10:53: i/o timeout in the logs.
Reported by Jane Doe <jane.doe@example.com>.

2026-10-07 09:12:41 - Jane Doe (Work notes)
Root cause: a default-deny egress policy blocked DNS. Checked with @jdoe; call +1 555 123 4567 or mail jane.doe@example.com if it comes back.
Added an egress NetworkPolicy rule for DNS to openshift-dns on port 5353.

fields.summary: Certificate expired on the internal API route (case 7)
fields.description:
Caller: Raj Patel
x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid for api.internal.example.test.
Reported by Raj Patel <raj.patel@example.org>.

comments.body:
2026-10-08 09:12:41 - Raj Patel (Work notes)
Cause was a manually created certificate that nobody renewed. Checked with @rpatel; call (555) 987-6543 or mail raj.patel@example.org if it comes back.
Renewed the certificate in cert-manager and switched the route to reencrypt with the new CA.

fields.summary: Node NotReady after kubelet disk pressure (case 8)

content.text:
Caller: Ana Lima
Node worker-3 NotReady; kubelet reports DiskPressure and evicts pods.
Reported by Ana Lima <ana.lima@example.net>.

2026-10-09 09:12:41 - Ana Lima (Work notes)
Root cause: image garbage collection thresholds were too high for the 60 GB disk. Checked with @alima; call +44 20 7946 0958 or mail ana.lima@example.net if it comes back.
Cleaned unused images and raised the image GC thresholds on the machine config pool.

fields.summary: Quota exceeded when scaling the checkout service (case 9)

fields.summary: HAProxy router pods restart at maxconn (case 10)

content.text:
